\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz,amsmath}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.misc,shapes.multipart}
\makeatletter
\expandafter\let\expandafter\originalrounded\csname pgf@sh@bg@rounded rectangle\endcsname
\expandafter\def\csname pgf@sh@bg@rounded rectangle\endcsname{%
  \typeout{ROUNDED BOX \tikz@fig@name: \the\wd\pgfnodeparttextbox,\the\ht\pgfnodeparttextbox,\the\dp\pgfnodeparttextbox}%
  \originalrounded}
\newcommand{\reportnode}[1]{%
  \pgfpointanchor{#1}{east}\typeout{ANCHOR #1/east: \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}%
  \pgfpointanchor{#1}{west}\typeout{ANCHOR #1/west: \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}%
  \pgfpointanchor{#1}{north}\typeout{ANCHOR #1/north: \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}%
  \pgfpointanchor{#1}{south}\typeout{ANCHOR #1/south: \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}}
\makeatother
\newcommand{\reportmath}[2]{%
  \setbox0=\hbox{$#2$}\typeout{MATH #1: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}}
\begin{document}
\reportmath{prime}{(\theta_1',\psi_1')}
\reportmath{cal}{(\mathcal{T},\mathcal{R})}
\reportmath{cal-script}{\mathcal{T}_i}
\reportmath{cal-group}{\mathcal{T_i}}
\reportmath{cal-prime}{\mathcal{R}'}
\reportmath{primes}{f'+f''+f'''}
{\scriptsize\reportmath{small-primes}{\theta_1'+\mathcal{T}_i+\mathcal{R}'}}
{\boldmath\reportmath{bold-primes}{\theta_1'+\mathcal{T}_i+\mathcal{R}'}}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node[rounded rectangle,draw,thick,align=center] (A1) {Agent 1\\$(\theta_1',\psi_1')$};
  \reportnode{A1}
  \node[rounded rectangle,draw,thick,align=center] (AN) {Agent $n$\\$(\theta_n',\psi_n')$};
  \reportnode{AN}
  \node[rounded rectangle,draw,thick,align=center] (G) {Global state\\$(\theta,\psi)$};
  \reportnode{G}
  \node[rounded rectangle,draw,thick,align=center] (E1) {Env. 1\\$(\mathcal{T},\mathcal{R})$};
  \reportnode{E1}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
